title: Restart from pause menu leaves game paused instead of running
observed: After pause then clicking btn-restart, the game stays in mode paused with the pause menu still shown.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away.

title: Spikes at score 0 wrap the score to 65036 instead of clamping at 0
observed: Stepping onto spikes with score 0 shows score 65036 (wrapped negative value) instead of 0.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes below.

title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause is applied before pausing
observed: In the tick pause+right, the player moves from (1,1) to (2,1) while the game becomes paused.
expected: When the game becomes paused, the rest of that tick's input is ignored; the player should not move.
